name: psychology-mcp
description: Psychology MCP: the field explained across cognitive, developmental, social, personality, learning & behaviour, clinical theory, biological, kinesics/nonverbal, and research methods — plus a replication-aware verify loop that grades any 'is this true?' claim, and a myth list for the folklore that did not hold up.
